label: wb_knowledge
what: Search the Arma Reforger modding knowledge base — distilled pattern files covering scripting, audio, weapons, vehicles, AI, UI, game modes, animation, and all other modding domains.

label: wb_launch

label: wb_link

label: wb_menu
what: Workbench menu items from the census ledger.

label: wb_open_resource

label: wb_play
what: Switch Workbench to game (play) mode.

label: wb_projects
what: Query project information from the Workbench.

label: wb_reload
what: Alias of wb_scripts reload: ReloadScripts, then a re-ping.

label: wb_save
what: Alias of wb_module save on the World Editor.

label: wb_scripts
what: Script compile train through Workbench's natives.

label: wb_settings
what: Workbench settings store.

label: wb_state
what: Get a full snapshot of the current Workbench state.

label: wb_stop
what: Stop game mode and return to the World Editor.

label: wb_undo_redo
what: Undo or redo the last action in the World Editor.

what: Regex-only check of a character `.agr` GlobalTags block (WEAPON, ADS, STANCE ...).

label: wiki_read
what: Read the full content of a specific wiki page by title.

label: wiki_search
what: Search pre-downloaded Bohemia Interactive Wiki (BIKI) content, tutorials, and guides about Enfusion engine concepts, scripting patterns, and Arma Reforger modding topics.

label: workshop_check_deps
what: Read a `.gproj` from disk, extract its Dependencies block, and resolve each dep GUID the way WORKBENCH does: against the Workbench addons dir, the folders next to the project, and the base game + Tools installs.

label: workshop_info
what: Read Workshop metadata from a mod's .gproj file.

label: workshop_validate_manifest

label: world_compose_summary

label: world_diff
what: Semantic diff between two Enfusion text files (typically `.ent` worlds or `.layer` files).

label: world_validate_refs
what: File-scoped variant of `find_broken_refs`.
